title: I built a downhill skiing game with Claude Code in about a week
author: ThenSeaworthiness692
selftext:
I’ve been working on a game called Powder Run for the past week using Claude Code.

[https://powderrungame.com](https://powderrungame.com/)

It’s a downhill skiing and snowboarding game where you race to the bottom of the mountain as fast as possible, dodging obstacles, hitting jumps, and trying to set your best time. You can also challenge friends on the same course and see who gets the better time.

I started with Fable 5 to get the first version together, then used Sonnet to keep iterating on the gameplay, UI, bugs, and features.

Would love any feedback on the gameplay, controls, or anything you’d change.

comments.author: paulordbm
comments.body: When you go left/right the rotation of your character is on an inverted signal.

replies.author: ThenSeaworthiness692
replies.body: Good catch, you’re right. The character rotation is flipped when turning left/right. I’ll fix that.
